title: Explore Human Tissue Portals
bodyHtml:
Explore our portals centered around human tissues

The Mammalian Adipose Tissue Knowledge Portal (MATKP) A developing open community resource for multi-species mammalian adipose biology. Initial features include harmonized transcriptomic datasets from human and mouse tissues, human genetic data, and adipose-relevant genomic annotations. Explore or contribute your data today. Visit resource
PanKbase A comprehensive, centralized resource for the study of the human pancreas and diabetes. PanKbase aims to integrate multi-source type 1 diabetes (T1D) datasets with expert-curated knowledge in a centralized, open-source data hub. Since users can contribute their own data, this is a repository for reproducible, collaborative research of the pancreas and T1D. Visit resource
